verdict.rationale: There is no documented way to define explicit rules or event triggers. The closest evidence is a reviewer giving Instinct a standing natural-language instruction to handle incoming podcast-booking follow-ups and ping him only when needed (instinct-comm-11). The vendor also describes acting on email and messaging events without prompting, such as following up on dropped threads and proactively calling or texting (instinct-docs-3, instinct-comm-17). But that behaviour is the agent's own discretion, not rules the user defines. missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule or trigger mechanism, a list of supported event types, rule management (view, edit, disable), first-party docs on standing instructions, and hands-on confirmation that triggers fire reliably.
